hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$content = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT; $violations = @(); if ($content -cmatch '(?i)\bcuda\b|CUDAExecutionProvider|torch\.cuda|from cuda|import cuda|\.to\(.cuda.\)') { $violations += 'CUDA erkannt (IRON RULE 1: nur DirectML!)' }; if ($content -cmatch '(?i)\brocm\b|ROCmExecutionProvider|hip_runtime') { $violations += 'ROCm erkannt (IRON RULE 1: nur DirectML!)' }; if ($content -cmatch '(?i)\bnvenc\b|h264_nvenc|hevc_nvenc|av1_nvenc') { $violations += 'NVENC erkannt (IRON RULE 4: nur h264_amf/hevc_amf/av1_amf!)' }; if ($content -cmatch '(?i)\bpynvml\b|from pynvml|import pynvml') { $violations += 'pynvml erkannt (IRON RULE 5: nur LibreHardwareMonitor!)' }; if ($content -cmatch 'numpy>=2\.|numpy==2\.|numpy~=2\.') { $violations += 'NumPy 2.x erkannt (IRON RULE 3: nur numpy<2.0 / 1.26.4!)' }; if ($violations.Count -gt 0) { Write-Error \"IRON RULE VERLETZUNG:`n$($violations -join \"`n\")\"; exit 1 }"
